source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC/BIOS in BIOS and send BMC raw command 0x30 0x20.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and correct versions before and after flashing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Filters assumed FirmwareInventory entries with the regex HIB|CPLD.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires exact HIB-CPLD member identity, complete inventory evidence and safe read-only access.

old_problem: The preserved method does not address HIB-CPLD, and DeepSeek's broad name regex can select another HIB-related firmware object or any CPLD without proving which version is active.
disposition_reason: This row's version-check identity and before/after oracle are sufficiently clear for a component-bound read-only contract. The HIB-CPLD inventory identity, active-version property and expected releases are intentionally runtime configuration. No BMC/BIOS value or regex match is silently substituted for the requested bridge CPLD.
decision_basis: XLSX row 741 and its DeepSeek, GPT V2 and historical record were read directly.
Version inspection has a safe non-mutating method once the platform maps the HIB-CPLD to one stable inventory object.
ED-36 and user rule C classify missing member IDs and Expected versions as readiness facts; ED-35 prevents BMC-version evidence from reducing HIB-CPLD coverage.
Redfish inventory is discoverable, but OEM member identity and whether a Version is active or staged require platform confirmation.

test_case.test_name: Verify the active HIB-CPLD firmware version across the approved firmware change
test_case.purpose: Read the same physical HIB-CPLD's authoritative active-version field before and after the separately controlled flash and compare each checkpoint with the approved release matrix.
required_package: HIB board/slot/FRU and CPLD inventory-member identity
Supported Redfish or OEM read-only version property and active-versus-staged semantics
Approved pre/post HIB-CPLD versions and flash activation record
Secure BMC client, CA trust and optional vendor decoder
test_case.test_command: Discover and save the complete read-only firmware inventory, then select the owner-approved HIB-CPLD resource by stable ID/location/related-item—not by `HIB|CPLD` regex—and read its documented active Version. Repeat against the same resource after activation. Use raw 0x30/0x20 only when its approved decoder binds the response to this HIB-CPLD.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one selected member maps to the intended HIB-CPLD. Its active version equals the approved baseline before the flash and the approved target afterward, while the member identity/location remains stable and BMC/host/SEL health stays acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact member mapping, active-version equality at both checkpoints and clean correlated health. FAIL includes wrong member, staged-only value, unexpected unchanged version after a completed activation, malformed data or health regression. An HTTP 200, Name match or BMC version cannot decide PASS.
safety_gate: No UpdateService write, BMC reset, CPLD flash or undocumented OEM raw request
Stop on multiple HIB/CPLD candidates or active/staged ambiguity without changing state
expected_evidence: HIB-CPLD FRU/location and stable inventory URI
Full service discovery and all relevant member documents
Documented active-version field with pre/post expected comparison
Referenced flash/activation timeline and BMC/SEL/host health
test_case.recovery: Because this row only reads state, recovery is evidence preservation and escalation. Do not reset or reflash when inventory identity or version disagrees.

source_conflict.resolution: HIB-CPLD is the review-layer target; unrelated source steps are retained but cannot satisfy its coverage.

blocked.reason: The review now has a deterministic safe pattern; member mapping and expected values are Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact HIB-CPLD member, active-version semantics and approved before/after versions.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046 2025.2
external_authorities.use: FirmwareInventory is a linked inventory collection; platform mapping is still required to select the HIB-CPLD instance.
